PushUpgradeCustomization.name: PushUpgradeCustomization
PushUpgradeCustomization.description: Customized push upgrades allow a package subscriber to block push upgrades to their org. Package developers control which subscribers can opt into customized push upgrades. Each push upgrade customization maps to a specific package and to a specific subscriber org.

CustomUpgradeType.description: The type of push upgrade customization.

ExpirationDays.description: The number of days that a subscriber is allowed to block push upgrades.

HasRestrictionEnabled.description: Indicates whether the subscriber org has blocked push upgrades.

IsCustomUpgradeAllowed.description: Indicates whether the package developer has allowed a subscriber to opt into customized push upgrades.

IsRestrictionOverridden.description: Indicates whether customized push upgrades have been overridden by Salesforce Customer Support for the subscriber org.

PushUpgradeBlockInitiatedDate.description: The date that IsCustomUpgradeAllowed was set to true.
